champions.name: Hecarim
champions.title: The Shadow of War

passive.name: Warpath
passive.full: Hecarim gains bonus attack damage equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed. Ghost, Dead Man's Plate, and Celerity all give Hecarim AD.

q.name: Rampage
q.full: Swing weapon dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. Each hit on an enemy reduces Rampage's cooldown by 1 second (stacks). Spammable at max stacks.

w.name: Spirit of Dread
w.brief: AoE damage + heal from nearby damage dealt.
w.full: Deal magic damage per second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Hecarim heals for a percentage of all damage dealt by any source to enemies within the area.

e.name: Devastating Charge
e.brief: Charge with increasing MS. Next AA knocks back.
e.full: Gain ramping movement speed over 3 seconds. Next auto-attack during charge deals bonus physical damage based on distance traveled and knocks the target back.

r.name: Onslaught of Shadows
r.brief: Charge forward. Fears enemies at destination.
r.full: Charge forward with spectral riders, dealing magic damage to enemies passed through. At the destination, release a shockwave that fears nearby enemies for 0.75-1.5 seconds.

passive.name: Signature of the Visionary
passive.brief: Damaging champions with abilities marks them. Allies deal bonus damage.
passive.full: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemy champions. Allied champion attacks on marked targets deal bonus magic damage.

q.name: Subject: Disaster

q.full: QQ: Fire a long-range line skillshot. QW: Create a damaging zone. QE: Fire a long-range poke missile. Each has different damage patterns.

w.name: Subject: Serenity
w.brief: 3 spell options: shield, MS zone, or attack speed zone.
w.full: WQ: Grant shield to ally. WW: Create a movement speed zone. WE: Create an attack speed zone. Utility spells.

e.name: Subject: Torment
e.brief: 3 spell options: root, fear zone, or pull.
e.full: EQ: Root target area. EW: Create a fear zone. EE: Pull enemies toward center. CC spells.

r.name: Spiraling Despair
r.brief: AoE expanding zone that deals damage and reduces MR.
r.full: Create an expanding zone of paint that deals magic damage and reduces enemies' magic resistance. Persists and grows.

champions.name: Irelia
champions.title: The Blade Dancer

passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.brief: Stacking AS on ability hits. At max, AAs deal bonus magic damage.
passive.full: Hitting enemies with abilities grants stacks of Ionian Fervor (max 4). Each stack grants bonus attack speed. At max stacks, auto-attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit.

q.name: Bladesurge
q.brief: Dash to target. Kills/marks reset CD. Heals on minion kill.
q.full: Dash to target enemy dealing physical damage. If the target is killed or marked by E/R, Bladesurge's cooldown is reset. Heals on minion/monster kill.

w.name: Defiant Dance
w.brief: Channel damage reduction. Release for AoE damage.
w.full: Channel for up to 1.5 seconds, reducing all incoming damage by 40-60% (physical) and 20-30% (magic). Release to deal physical damage in a line. Damage scales with channel duration.

e.name: Flawless Duet
e.brief: Place 2 blades. They converge and stun enemies between.
e.full: Place a blade at target location. Recast to place second blade. Both blades converge, stunning and damaging enemies caught between them. Marks stunned enemies for Q reset.

r.name: Vanguard's Edge
r.brief: Launch blades in a line. Create a cage that damages and slows on walls.
r.full: Launch a barrage of blades in a line dealing magic damage and marking all enemy champions hit. The blades form a cage around the first champion hit — cage walls deal damage and slow enemies who pass through.

r.name: Mercury Cannon / Hammer

passive.name: Whisper
passive.brief: 4-shot revolver. 4th shot crits + bonus %HP. AS → AD conversion.
passive.full: Jhin's gun has 4 bullets. The 4th shot always crits and deals bonus damage based on target's missing HP. Jhin cannot gain attack speed normally — AS is converted to bonus AD. Crits grant bonus movement speed.

q.full: Throw a grenade that bounces between enemies up to 4 times. Each kill increases the next bounce's damage by 35%.

w.name: Deadly Flourish
w.brief: Long-range line skillshot. Roots marked targets.
w.full: Fire a long-range shot dealing physical damage. Enemy champions recently damaged by Jhin or allies, or who step on a Lotus Trap, are marked. Marked targets hit by W are rooted.

e.name: Captive Audience
e.brief: Place invisible traps that slow + reveal + deal damage.
e.full: Place an invisible trap at target location. When triggered: reveal, slow, and deal magic damage to enemies in the area. Charges stored.

r.name: Curtain Call
r.brief: Channel 4 long-range shots. 4th shot crits + executes.
r.full: Channel for up to 10 seconds. Fire up to 4 super-long-range shots that deal physical damage, slow, and reveal enemies hit. The 4th shot crits and deals bonus damage based on missing HP.
